metadata.description: Decision memory for human- and agent-authored plans.

plugins.name: adrkit
plugins.description: Load the architecture decisions that govern a change, check work against them, and audit code, documentation, and history for decisions that were never recorded. Ships decision-memory and decision-backfill skills, a read-only decision-checker agent, and five slash commands, plus an advisory adr-review workflow and two canvases for GitHub Copilot, all driven by the adr CLI. Ships no MCP server: wire adrkit's MCP server per project.
